nodes.description: Reentrancy guard flag set/cleared by the nonReentrant modifier.
Administrator address; gate for privileged cToken and comptroller functions.
Pending administrator that must call _acceptAdmin to take over the role.
Comptroller contract enforcing policy hooks such as transferAllowed and borrowAllowed.
Interest rate model used to compute borrow and supply rates.
Underlying ERC-20 asset of the market; target of external token calls.
Total outstanding borrows of the market, updated on accrual, borrow and repay.
Reserves of the market, moved by _addReservesFresh and _reduceReservesFresh.
cToken balance mapping mutated by transfer, mint, redeem and seize.
Total number of cTokens in circulation.
Delegate implementation address used by delegatecall in the delegator contracts.
Selects supply (0) or borrow (1) CHEESE mining rule; changeable by admin.
Amount of CHEESE distributed per block by the flywheel.
Accumulator of total earned interest since the market opened.
Block number of last accrual; freshness checks compare it to block.number.
ERC-20 allowance mapping consumed by transferTokens.
BorrowSnapshot mapping of principal and interestIndex per borrower.
One-time market initializer; requires msg.sender == admin and sets comptroller, IRM, name, symbol and decimals.
nonReentrant ERC-20 transfer that forwards to transferTokens with msg.sender.
nonReentrant ERC-20 transferFrom that forwards to transferTokens.
Internal transfer logic; queries comptroller, mutates balances and calls comptroller.transferVerify.
Sets the allowance of spender on behalf of msg.sender.
nonReentrant seize entry point that uses msg.sender as the seizing cToken.
Moves cTokens from borrower to liquidator using subUInt/addUInt and comptroller.seizeVerify.
nonReentrant wrapper that accrues interest then calls mintFresh with msg.sender.
Performs the mint: doTransferIn, exchange-rate math, balance updates and mintVerify hook.
nonReentrant wrapper that accrues interest then calls redeemFresh.
Computes redeem amounts and performs doTransferOut before writing totalSupply/accountTokens.
nonReentrant wrapper that accrues interest then calls borrowFresh.
Checks comptroller.borrowAllowed and performs doTransferOut before writing borrow balances.
Repays a borrow: doTransferIn then subUInt accounting and repayBorrowVerify hook.
nonReentrant liquidation entry that accrues interest on both markets before proceeding.
Full liquidation path: policy hook, repayBorrowFresh, seize-token calculation and collateral seizure.
Accrues interest from the block delta using checked math and writes borrowIndex, totalBorrows and totalReserves.
Privileged setter for pendingAdmin guarded by msg.sender == admin.
Privileged function that promotes pendingAdmin to admin after checking msg.sender.
Privileged setter for the comptroller guarded by msg.sender == admin.
Privileged setter for the delegate implementation guarded by msg.sender == admin; may call _resignImplementation and _becomeImplementation.
Internal helper performing delegatecall to an arbitrary callee with arbitrary data.
Delegates execution to the stored implementation address.
View helper using staticcall into delegateToImplementation with msg.data.
Performs the final delegatecall to the implementation and forwards raw return data.
External entry point that requires msg.sender == tx.origin before recomputing CHEESE speeds.
Recomputes per-market CHEESE speeds and writes compSpeeds.
Signature based delegation using ecrecover, nonce and an expiry compared against block.timestamp.
Internal delegation logic updating delegates and moving vote checkpoints.
Moves vote weight between delegates using add96/sub96 arithmetic.
Writes a vote checkpoint using safe32 on block.number and adds to numCheckpoints.
CErc20 transfer-in that calls transferFrom on the underlying and measures the real balance delta.
CErc20 transfer-out that calls transfer on the underlying token.
CDai transfer-in that sweeps DAI into the DSR pot via daiJoin.join and pot.join.
CDai transfer-out that exits DAI from the DSR pot and daiJoin.
CEther transfer-out using address.transfer for native Ether.
Admin-only reserve reduction that performs doTransferOut to the admin.
Adds reserves by performing doTransferIn from msg.sender and checking overflow.
Untrusted caller address used for authorization checks and as fund source.
Untrusted timestamp used as the signature expiry bound in delegateBySig.
Untrusted transaction origin used as the authorization condition in refreshCompSpeeds.
External call to comptroller.transferVerify after balance mutations in transferTokens.
delegatecall inside delegateTo executing arbitrary callee code in this storage context.
delegatecall to the implementation contract forwarding raw msg.data and return data.
staticcall wrapping a delegate call for view functions.
ecrecover used to derive the signatory of a delegation signature.
External call PotLike.drip() executed while accruing interest in the CDai delegate.
External ERC-20 transfer/transferFrom on the untrusted underlying token.
External policy call comptroller.borrowAllowed executed by borrowFresh.
External policy call comptroller.liquidateBorrowAllowed executed by liquidateBorrowFresh.
uint96 vote balance arithmetic in add96/sub96 used by the Cheese checkpointing logic.
Checked arithmetic addUInt/subUInt/mulUInt/divUInt used for interest and balance accounting.
CEther doTransferOut performing address.transfer of native Ether to an arbitrary recipient.
Caller supplied amount of underlying to supply during mint.
Caller supplied number of cTokens to redeem.
Caller supplied amount of underlying to borrow.
Caller supplied repayment amount, possibly uint(-1) for full repay.
Borrower account being liquidated or repaid on behalf of.
Number of collateral cTokens to seize from the borrower.
Account receiving the seized collateral.
New pending administrator address supplied to _setPendingAdmin.
New delegate implementation address supplied to _setImplementation.
Raw calldata forwarded to _becomeImplementation on the new implementation.
Address receiving delegated votes in delegateBySig.
Memory struct holding intermediate mint calculations in mintFresh.
Local snapshot of getBlockNumber() used by accrueInterest.
Number of blocks elapsed since last accrual in accrueInterest.
CDai override that drips the DSR pot before delegating to super.accrueInterest.
Cheese internal transfer that mutates balances with add96/sub96 and moves delegates.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as both spender and src when forwarding to transferTokens.
_setPendingAdmin returns UNAUTHORIZED unless msg.sender equals admin.
_acceptAdmin requires msg.sender to equal pendingAdmin.
_setImplementation requires msg.sender to equal admin.
initialize requires msg.sender to equal admin before setting market parameters.
msg.sender is forwarded as the seizerToken of seizeInternal.
msg.sender is used as the minter passed to mintFresh.
delegateBySig compares block.timestamp against the user supplied expiry, a timestamp dependency.
refreshCompSpeeds authorizes callers by requiring msg.sender == tx.origin.
transfer is protected by the nonReentrant modifier reading _notEntered.
transferFrom is protected by the nonReentrant modifier reading _notEntered.
mintInternal is protected by the nonReentrant modifier reading _notEntered.
redeemInternal is protected by the nonReentrant modifier reading _notEntered.
borrowInternal is protected by the nonReentrant modifier reading _notEntered.
seize is protected by the nonReentrant modifier reading _notEntered.
liquidateBorrowInternal is protected by the nonReentrant modifier reading _notEntered.
mintFresh performs doTransferIn on the untrusted underlying token before updating totalSupply and accountTokens.
redeemFresh calls doTransferOut to the caller-controlled address before writing totalSupply and accountTokens.
borrowFresh calls doTransferOut before writing accountBorrows and totalBorrows.
repayBorrowFresh calls doTransferIn on the untrusted underlying before updating borrow balances.
_addReservesFresh calls doTransferIn from msg.sender before updating totalReserves.
_reduceReservesFresh calls doTransferOut to admin after updating totalReserves.
transferTokens invokes the comptroller transferVerify hook as a post-transfer external call.
delegateTo performs a delegatecall to an arbitrary callee with caller supplied data.
delegateAndReturn delegatecalls the stored implementation address with raw msg.data.
delegateToViewAndReturn wraps delegateToImplementation in a staticcall.
delegateBySig derives the authorized signatory from ecrecover output.
CDai accrueInterest calls the external PotLike.drip() before accruing CToken interest.
borrowFresh queries the comptroller borrowAllowed policy hook externally.
liquidateBorrowFresh queries the comptroller liquidateBorrowAllowed policy hook externally.
accrueInterest relies on checked CarefulMath operations for index and balance calculations.
_moveDelegates uses add96/sub96 uint96 arithmetic on vote balances.
_writeCheckpoint increments numCheckpoints with uint32 arithmetic.
_transferTokens uses add96/sub96 for sender and receiver balances.
CEther doTransferOut sends Ether with address.transfer to a user controlled recipient.
refreshCompSpeeds delegates the recomputation to refreshCompSpeedsInternal.
_setImplementation calls delegateToImplementation for resign and become hooks.
delegateToImplementation forwards to delegateTo with the stored implementation.
delegateToViewAndReturn staticcalls delegateToImplementation.
delegateAndReturn reads the implementation storage slot to build the delegatecall target.
mintInternal accrues interest before performing the mint.
redeemInternal accrues interest before performing the redeem.
borrowInternal accrues interest before performing the borrow.
liquidateBorrowFresh calls seizeInternal when the collateral market is this contract.
seizeInternal decrements the borrower and increments the liquidator balance in accountTokens.
mintAmount parameter flows into mintFresh accounting.
redeemTokens parameter flows into redeemFresh token accounting.
borrowAmount parameter flows into borrowFresh accounting.
repayAmount parameter flows into repayBorrowFresh accounting.
borrower parameter determines whose debt is liquidated.
seizeTokens parameter is subtracted from the borrower balance in seizeInternal.
liquidator parameter receives the seized tokens in seizeInternal.
newPendingAdmin parameter is written into pendingAdmin.
implementation_ parameter is written into the implementation storage slot.
becomeImplementationData is forwarded to the new implementation hook.
delegatee parameter is hashed into the signed digest and used for delegation.
vars_MintLocalVars holds the intermediate mint values inside mintFresh.
currentBlockNumber drives the interest accrual block delta.
blockDelta is used to derive simpleInterestFactor and the new borrow index.
